producer: webpack --mode production --config-name webviews:common --config-name webviews --env analyzeBundle --env quick
budgetRationale: Re-baselined for the Graph access walls: +14.5 KiB on the entrypoint since the localization baseline, of which +10.7 KiB is graph.js and +3.9 KiB is shared.js. Most of it accumulated within headroom (the graph rollup rework, plural blocks for count messages); the access walls pushed it over, adding a show-intent derivation and task-specific wall copy (intentCopy.ts, access-account.ts, feature-gate styles) with their localized messages. Growth is feature code, not a new dependency or a module moving between chunks. Ceilings keep their prior headroom: 12 KiB above baseline on the entrypoint for host-neutral extension seams, 4 KiB on shared.js (loaded by every webview) so unrelated shared-code changes don't trip a graph check while real bloat still does, and graph.css's accounted allowance for the gl-commit-graph element rename and the VS Code theme-token table.
